about_the_game:
Boffins History Quiz Reel isn't your average, dusty history test. It's a relentless trial by trivia, 1 game, 45 questions long, graded designed to challenge, entertain, and surprise even the most seasoned history buff. From the fall of Rome to the rise of Silicon Valley, our questions span the breadth of human achievement and folly. How much do you really remember?

Go From Enthusiast to Expert

  • Never the Same Quiz Twice: A massive, randomized pool of 300+ questions ensures infinite replayability. You'll never get comfortable.

  • Climb the Ranks: It's not just about being right; it's about being fast and consistent. Fight for the top spot on the global leaderboards.

  • Unlock Your Achievements: Earn bragging rights by conquering specific historical eras and acing difficult categories.

  • Knowledge is Power: Every question you answer—right or wrong—helps you learn fascinating new details about our shared past.

Features:

  • Full Controller, Mouse, and Keyboard Support

  • Global Leaderboards

  • Dozens of Achievements to Unlock

  • A Growing Library of Challenging Questions

You've watched the documentaries and read the books. Now, it's time to put your knowledge to the ultimate test. Wishlist Boffins History Quiz Reel today!

On Game Launch 30% discount for a short period, to get the quiz trivia started.
